items.prompt: Rewrite for a customer's purchasing director (formal email).
items.source: Hi Tom, the shipment's gonna be late again, sorry. Can you push the launch back a week?
items.model: Dear Mr Hughes, I regret to inform you that the shipment will be delayed once again. Would it be possible to postpone the launch by one week?
keyChanges: gonna → will be
sorry → I regret to inform you
push back → postpone
Can you…? → Would it be possible to…?

items.source: We messed up the invoice — we'll sort it out ASAP.
items.model: Please accept our apologies for the error on the invoice, which we will rectify as soon as possible.
keyChanges: messed up → an error (and an explicit apology)
sort out → rectify
ASAP → as soon as possible

items.source: Sales went up a lot because we cut prices.
items.model: Sales rose significantly as a result of the price reductions.
keyChanges: went up a lot → rose significantly
because we cut prices → as a result of the price reductions (nominalisation)

items.prompt: Rewrite for a new business contact.
items.source: Just checking — did you get my email about the contract?
items.model: I am writing to confirm whether you received my email regarding the contract.
keyChanges: Just checking → I am writing to confirm
get → receive
about → regarding

items.source: We can't do that price, it's way too low.
items.model: Unfortunately, we are unable to accept that price, as it falls considerably below our minimum.
keyChanges: can't do → are unable to accept
way too low → falls considerably below our minimum
Add a softener: Unfortunately

items.source: Let's get together next week and talk it through.
items.model: I would welcome the opportunity to meet next week to discuss the matter in detail.
keyChanges: Let's get together → I would welcome the opportunity to meet
talk it through → discuss the matter in detail

items.source: The new guy is great — he's really good with clients.
items.model: Our new colleague has proved highly effective in managing client relationships.
keyChanges: The new guy → Our new colleague
is great / really good → has proved highly effective
with clients → in managing client relationships

items.prompt: Rewrite for a product comparison sent to a client.
items.source: Our competitor's product is cheap and nasty.
items.model: Our competitor's product is less expensive, but of noticeably lower quality.
keyChanges: cheap → less expensive / inexpensive
nasty → of noticeably lower quality (neutral, factual)

items.prompt: Rewrite for a client you've kept waiting.
items.source: Sorry for the late reply, I've been snowed under.
items.model: Please accept my apologies for the delayed response; I have had an exceptionally heavy workload.
keyChanges: Sorry → Please accept my apologies
late reply → delayed response
snowed under → an exceptionally heavy workload

items.prompt: Rewrite as a quick message to a colleague you know well.
items.source: We would be grateful if you could provide an update at your earliest convenience.
items.model: Could you let us know how things are going when you get a chance?
keyChanges: We would be grateful if you could → Could you
provide an update → let us know how things are going
at your earliest convenience → when you get a chance

items.prompt: Rewrite as a team chat message.
items.source: Please be advised that the meeting has been rescheduled to Thursday.
items.model: Just a heads-up: the meeting's moved to Thursday.
keyChanges: Please be advised → Just a heads-up
has been rescheduled → 's moved (active, contracted)

items.prompt: Rewrite as a friendly reply to a distributor you know well.
items.source: We regret that we are unable to accommodate your request on this occasion.
items.model: Sorry, we can't do it this time.
keyChanges: We regret that → Sorry
are unable to accommodate your request → can't do it
on this occasion → this time

items.prompt: Rewrite as a follow-up to a colleague.
items.source: Further to our conversation, I enclose the revised figures.
items.model: Following up on our chat — here are the updated numbers.
keyChanges: Further to our conversation → Following up on our chat
I enclose → here are
revised figures → updated numbers

items.prompt: Rewrite as a message to your team.
items.source: It has come to my attention that the deadline may not be met.
items.model: Looks like we might miss the deadline.
keyChanges: It has come to my attention → Looks like
may not be met → we might miss (active, personal)
